title: Gluing local closed representatives of a source-local predicate
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Assign a proposition $P(T,h)$ to every scheme $T$ and morphism $h:T\to X$. Assume that $P(T,h)$ implies $P(V,h\circ\iota_V)$ for every open subscheme $V\subseteq T$ [def-weil-open-immersion]. Assume that $P(T,h)$ holds if every point of $T$ has an open neighbourhood $V$ with $P(V,h\circ\iota_V)$. Finally, assume that each point $x\in X$ has an open neighbourhood $U$ and a closed immersion $i:Z_U\to U$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], such that for every scheme $T$ and $h:T\to U$, factorization through $i$ is equivalent to $P(T,\iota_U\circ h)$. Then there is a closed immersion $q:Z\to X$ locally of finite presentation such that, for every scheme $T$ and $h:T\to X$, factorization through $q$ is equivalent to $P(T,h)$. Stability under arbitrary base change is not assumed.

proof.text: Choose local representatives at all points. Put F_x=i_x composed with the chart inclusion, a monomorphism. Let V_xy=F_x^{-1}(U_y), open in Z_x. Applying the local factorization criterion to the identity shows P(F_x). Restriction stability and the criterion on U_y give a lift from V_xy into Z_y. Its image lies in V_yx, so lift it into that open. The resulting transition maps commute with F_x. On self-overlaps V_xx=Z_x. All transition identities follow by cancellation of these monomorphisms. Construct the triple-overlap pullback lifts; cancellation gives the cocycle.

Apply Scheme.GlueData to this explicit cocycle. Its glued object and jointly surjective open chart inclusions give a morphism q to X by Multicoequalizer.desc. Its inverse image of U_x equals the range of the x-th glued chart: a point from another chart lying over U_x is moved by the transition map. IsOpenImmersion.isPullback identifies the local representative with the pullback of q to U_x. Closed immersion and local finite presentation follow from Mathlib IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover and these pullback identifications.

For a factor T->Z->X, each point of T has an open neighbourhood whose map into Z lifts into a glued chart. The local representing criterion gives P on this neighbourhood; source locality gives P on T. Conversely pull a map satisfying P back to the inverse images of all U_x. Restriction stability and local criteria give lifts into local representatives, hence into Z. Since q is a monomorphism they agree on overlaps. Cover.glueMorphisms and Cover.hom_ext produce the global lift and its factorization identity. The same construction works for empty X and T; source locality implies P for the empty source.

theorem exists_closedLocus_of_local_charts
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (P : ∀ T : Scheme.{u}, (T ⟶ X) → Prop)
    (hrestrict : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (h : T ⟶ X) (V : T.Opens),
      P T h → P V.toScheme (V.ι ≫ h))
    (hlocal : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (h : T ⟶ X),
      (∀ x : T, ∃ V : T.Opens, x ∈ V ∧ P V.toScheme (V.ι ≫ h)) → P T h)
    (hcharts : ∀ x : X, ∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧
      ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z ⟶ V.toScheme),
        IsClosedImmersion i ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation i ∧
        (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (h : T ⟶ V.toScheme),
          (∃ g : T ⟶ Z, g ≫ i = h) ↔ P T (h ≫ V.ι))) :
    ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z ⟶ X),
      IsClosedImmersion i ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation i ∧
      (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (h : T ⟶ X),
        (∃ g : T ⟶ Z, g ≫ i = h) ↔ P T h)
